title: Mobile Engineer
descriptionText:
About the job:

*IN Tech is leading a search for a Mobile Engineer* on behalf of a rapidly growing, product-led technology company based in Atlanta.

This organization builds a widely used SaaS platform and is investing heavily in its mobile experience as part of its next phase of growth. They are seeking engineers with strong native mobile development experience (Swift and/or Kotlin) who enjoy building high-quality products in a collaborative engineering culture.

Great work/life balance, excellent benefits, smart team.

*Location:* Must be in or moving to Atlanta, GA (Hybrid – 2 days onsite)

Sorry, no 3rd parties. Must be eligible to work in the US without visa sponsorship or transfer at any time.

*What You'll Do*

*Build and scale mobile applications.*

You'll join a smart, collaborative engineering team responsible for owning and evolving a key domain of the company’s platform. You will help design, build, and maintain high-quality native mobile applications used by thousands of customers.

*Contribute to architecture and product evolution.*

Partner with engineers and product leaders to evaluate technical approaches, prioritize improvements, and drive thoughtful system design decisions.

*Write clean, maintainable code.*

Champion testing best practices, code quality, and thoughtful code reviews that elevate the entire team.

*Collaborate closely with teammates.*

Work in a highly collaborative engineering environment where mentorship, knowledge sharing, and open communication are valued.

*Continuously improve.*

Stay current on mobile frameworks, platform updates, and modern development practices while contributing ideas that improve both the product and the engineering organization.

*What You'll Need To Be Successful*

* Experience building native mobile applications (iOS and/or Android)
* Proficiency with Swift and/or Kotlin
* Strong understanding of mobile testing practices and code quality standards
* Experience working in collaborative engineering teams
* Participation in Agile development environments (sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog refinement)
* Familiarity with Apple and Google design principles and interface guidelines

Nice to Have

* Experience with push notifications and cloud messaging (FCM, APNS)
* Understanding of mobile security best practices
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs and backend services

Technologies & Tools

* Swift / SwiftUI
* Kotlin / Jetpack Compose
* Xcode
* Android Studio
* Firebase
* GitHub
* Jira / Confluence

Additional Details

* Hybrid schedule: 2 days per week in the Atlanta office
* Competitive compensation and strong benefits package
* Equity participation available
* Professional development and learning support
* Collaborative, product-focused engineering culture

Requirements added by the job poster

* No need for visa sponsorship

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30303

title: Mobile Engineer
descriptionText:
Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Cove the leading manufacturer of luxury kitchen appliances is a longstanding, family-owned company in the Madison area. Icons of design and paragons of performance and quality, Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Cove are the refrigeration, cooking, and dishwashing specialists found in world’s most luxurious homes. We look for team members who are driven by innovation and excellence, striving to serve our customers by doing what is right—with integrity, teamwork, and accountability.

 Growth and development are important aspects of this position. Whether you aspire to be a leader or a technical expert, this position will set you up for success in the future.

 Primary Responsibilities

 We are seeking a motivated individual to work as an iOS and Android mobile app developer. Candidates will participate on a team to develop and maintain mobile application software. This role involves using Flutter as a cross-platform development tool to help build and enhance our suite of mobile applications used by teams across the company and its partners.

 This position requires a strong understanding of quality software delivery, internal and external customer needs, and the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements. Since this position will deal with both technical personnel and business managers, as well as participate on project teams, strong interpersonal and communication skills are needed.

Primary Requirements

3-5 years of professional mobile development experience, with at least 2 years focused on Flutter and Dart
Strong understanding of mobile app architecture, RESTful APIs, and integrations with enterprise platforms (for example Microsoft Dynamics CRM, or web-based CMS solutions)
Proficient in creating responsive UI and maintaining consistent performance across Android and iOS devices
Familiarity with database objects and structures for data storage, retrieval and reporting according to project specifications.
Familiar with data modeling tools and methodologies, and knowledgeable in database system applications and stored procedures.
Analyze organizational data requirements and create logical and physical data flow models.
Address data quality issues with clients and management.
Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected.
Write code, perform code reviews with fellow developers, and debug software applications
Recommend system changes and enhancements
Serve as a model and mentor to IT Co-op developers and other developers that are less experienced.
Must be detail oriented, have strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Must understand and conceptualize applications from both a technical/programming perspective and a business point of view.
Perform all or part of the software development life cycle and follow a methodology.
Reviews, analyzes, and modifies programming systems including coding, testing, debugging and installing to support an organization's application systems.
The role’s primarily responsible for supporting the development, maintenance, and deployment of business facing & factory customer mobile applications.
Gather data and analyze business and user needs in consultation with both business managers and end-users
Must be able to work independently and as a part of a development team working on small, medium, large and enterprise projects.
Analyze business application requirements for functional business areas.
Gather business requirements and develop specifications for software solutions
Possess strong interview skills. Interview project stakeholders, document findings and make detailed recommendations.
Stay on top of industry changes, recommend and implement industry best practices

We value our employees by providing:

· Competitive compensation based on skills

· Industry-leading health, dental, and vision plans

· Generous 401 (K) savings and profit sharing

· On-site UW Health clinic, fitness center, and walking paths

· Education assistance and internal training programs

· Electric vehicle charging

· Maternity & paternity leave · Interested in learning more about the robust benefits package we offer? Click here!

· Hybrid work environment

This position requires a pre-employment drug/alcohol test and background check, which will be administered after a conditional job offer is extended. A negative drug/alcohol test result is required for employment. Refusal to take the test or a positive result may disqualify a candidate from further consideration. All drug testing will be conducted in accordance with federal and state laws.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
descriptionText:
Position: Senior Mobile Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Level: Senior

Location: Remote

Job type: PT Contract to Start with potential to become FT.

Pay: from $55/hr

About the Role

As a Mobile Software Engineer, you will work with the team to develop, sustain, and maintain software for Android and iOS mobile app platforms in enterprise ecosystems. These may include anything from companion mobile applications, IoT devices and services, and multimedia streaming applications.

Simply put, our team builds amazing mobile solutions. You will work with a team of talented designers, developers, and architects to develop custom mobile solutions for some of the best brands in the world.

Working here, you will be a part of a highly collaborative team. You will engage with our clients ensuring our custom mobile solutions are thoroughly tested and meet our high-quality standards. With the products you build, you will change people's lives by providing them with groundbreaking technology. The team does this by improving industry workflows and connecting companies with their customers.

At Camber, engineers participate in the successful execution of projects through self-organizing project teams. You will assist the product leadership with aligning time, budget, and functional requirements for optimal client and business outcomes, crafting code and approaches that simply and elegantly solve problems.

As is the expectation of all team members at Camber Creative, the boundaries of your involvement in company activities will not be limited by a formal job description. You should apply yourself to the full extent of your skills and capabilities to help in any and every way possible to maximize positive outcomes for client projects, the company, the team, and yourself.

Responsibilities
Work with one or more of Java, Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C
Develop custom Android/iOS mobile apps for clients across multiple industries
Unit-test code for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and reliability
Build solutions that change people's lives by providing them a technology that eases their pain
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and design new features
Work with product managers and UI/UX designers to create a secure, seamless mobile experience
Design, build, deploy, and support large, world-class enterprise-level solutions
Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality code
Design, build and maintain high-performance, reusable, and reliable code
Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the application
Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs
Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation
Minimum Qualifications
3+ years of demonstrable proficiency with Swift
3+ years of demonstrable proficiency with Kotlin
Knowledge of cross-platform solutions is a plus (React Native, Flutter, MAUI)
Experience with dependency management through Cocoapods, Swift Package Manager, and Gradle
Familiarity with LLDB, ADB, and similar debugging tools
Familiarity with RESTful APIs to connect mobile applications to back-end services
Familiarity with MVVM and other design patterns
Familiarity with SwiftUI
Experience with real-time messaging protocols
A solid understanding of the best practices of app design and supporting multiple device sizes and layouts
Understanding of Apple's design principles and interface guidelines
Understanding of Material design principles
Experience with e-commerce frameworks such as Stripe and StoreKit
Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
Ability to debug and fix retain cycles, memory leaks, and other memory management issues
Ability to evaluate performance issues with a complete understanding of the view layout system
Experience with stack trace debugging and investigation
Understanding of asynchronous programming concepts
Experience with video streaming protocols (HLS, DASH, WebRTC, RTSP)
Experience with production distribution (i.e. certificates, provisioning profiles)
Version control in a team environment and a strong knowledge of Git
Understanding the mobile development life cycle
Understanding of build configurations, schemes, and build variants
Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notifications (i.e. Firebase)

About Camber

Camber is a fully-distributed digital product agency specializing in app design and development for iOS, Android, web, and IoT. Our expert team collaborates from across the United States and Canada to plan, prototype, build, and sustain digital products that delight and enrich users' lives and produce meaningful business results for our client collaborators.

Whether it's a B2C app, internal enterprise utility tool, B2B Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform, the next innovative wearable or IoT solution, or anything in between, we have the deep expertise and insight to be equally comfortable as pilot, co-pilot, or navigator for our clients' next digital transformation.

A Principles-First Company

While what we do changes as technology evolves, what we believe in serves as the guardrails for everything we do. Our principles are:

Treat People Right
Work with Autonomy, Mastery, Purpose, and Accountability
Be an Excellent Collaborator
Assume Positive Intent
Strive for Simplicity
Show > Tell
Deliver, and Then Some
Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously
Always Be Improving

Camber was recently honored by being named to the Clutch 100 (https://clutch.co/press-releases/special-report-recognizes-top-b2b-service-providers-sustained-fast-growth-2021), which recognizes the top-growing B2B companies worldwide. We notched a top 25 position in sustained growth companies and a top 100 position in fastest growth companies.

Why Should I Join Camber?

We are people serving people. Relationships are everything to us. We start by hiring a team of not just skilled technicians, but deeply good human beings–because you can't pour from an empty cup. Then we treat every client, team, and collaborator relationship with humility, respect, and transparency, and look out for their best interests.
We are a team of highly experienced professionals, and we act like it. We want our subject matter experts to flex their skill mastery in their way every day. We align every task to an intended outcome and favor accountability over process obedience to maximize positive outcomes. After all, we will only succeed or fail together in our goal to make products that matter to our clients, their users, and our team.
We have only three company objectives, which are to operate an unparalleled workplace, to create an unparalleled client experience, and to make unparalleled user experiences. Everything we do is in service of these three human-centered objectives.

title: Mobile Engineer
descriptionText:
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks' platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

As part of Fireblocks, Dynamic represents the next evolution of non-custodial wallet infrastructure. Dynamic is Fireblocks' embedded wallet platform, purpose-built for developers who want to bring crypto and stablecoin experiences into modern applications without complexity. Together, Fireblocks and Dynamic are building the most complete, secure, and developer-friendly wallet infrastructure in the industry by combining institutional-grade security with consumer-grade experiences.

About the Team

Dynamic was founded in 2021 with a simple vision: every app and website will have a wallet component. That vision is rapidly becoming reality. Wallets are no longer limited to crypto-native products, they are becoming foundational infrastructure for payroll, remittances, and global payments. Dynamic powers wallet-based experiences for leading crypto and fintech teams including Kraken, zerohash, Magic Eden, and more.

Dynamic builds and maintains developer-first SDKs that enable teams to seamlessly integrate embedded wallet functionality directly into their applications. These embedded wallets allow end users to create, manage, and use wallets without leaving the product experience, making wallets feel like a native part of modern fintech and crypto apps.

As part of Fireblocks, the Dynamic team continues to build and scale the infrastructure and developer tooling that has onboarded 50M+ wallets across crypto and fintech applications. In this context, Dynamic powers the application-layer wallet experience and developer tooling, complementing Fireblocks' core custody, security, and transaction infrastructure. The team operates with a strong product mindset and deep focus on security, reliability, scalability, and exceptional developer experience. Engineers at Dynamic build secure-by-default systems and approach their work with a strong customer focus, balancing technical excellence with real-world user needs. You will be joining a passionate group that moves fast, works with the biggest names in payments and fintech, and is defining how the next generation of financial applications are built.

What You'll Do
Design and implement high-quality native mobile SDKs that enable developers to integrate embedded wallet functionality into their applications, with a strong focus on API ergonomics, performance, and reliability.
Own SDK features end-to-end: from API design and architecture, through implementation and testing, to release, versioning, and developer documentation.
Build and maintain secure, reliable SDK components for wallet operations, including cryptographic operations, blockchain interactions, and security-sensitive flows.
Define and evolve the SDK architecture to support long-term maintainability, backward compatibility, and adoption across diverse customer applications.
Build sample applications and demos that showcase SDK capabilities and serve as integration references for customers.
Create clear, comprehensive SDK documentation and integration guides.
Work with developer relations and support teams to address customer integration challenges.
Raise the bar for quality and operational excellence by establishing best practices around testing, observability, releases, and code health.
Contribute to a culture of ownership and execution, leading by example through hands-on work, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing
What You'll Bring
5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep focus on mobile development and shipping production-grade SDKs
Demonstrated track record of building and shipping high-quality code, with work you can point to and discuss in depth
Strong hands-on experience with iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin); experience with React Native or other cross-platform frameworks, and familiarity with all.
Experience building mobile SDKs or shared libraries, including API design, versioning, packaging, and long-term maintenance across platforms.
Experience with blockchain-enabled mobile systems, including wallet flows, signing, and on-chain interactions.
Experience working on security-sensitive mobile software, such as key management, secure storage, cryptography, or financial products.
Strong grasp of mobile engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and observability.
A get-things-done mindset with the ability to independently own problems and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Comfortable making long-term architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic and adaptable.
B.Sc. in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
Remote role in a distributed team; preference for candidates in the Americas time zone
Big Advantages
Rust and/or WebAssembly (Wasm) experience, particularly building cross-platform SDKs consumed by mobile apps.
Experience designing shared core logic used across iOS and Android.
Experience with advanced mobile security primitives (secure hardware, MPC, low-level crypto).
Prior experience owning or founding a mobile platform or SDK from scratch.

For employees hired to work from our NYC HQ, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range is specific to New York City, and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs.

It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $177,000 to $230,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of you deciding to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are.

Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

Please see our candidate privacy policy here.

  • Design and implement high-quality native mobile SDKs that enable developers to integrate embedded wallet functionality into their applications, with a strong focus on API ergonomics, performance, and reliability.
  • Own SDK features end-to-end: from API design and architecture, through implementation and testing, to release, versioning, and developer documentation.
  • Build and maintain secure, reliable SDK components for wallet operations, including cryptographic operations, blockchain interactions, and security-sensitive flows.
  • Define and evolve the SDK architecture to support long-term maintainability, backward compatibility, and adoption across diverse customer applications.
  • Build sample applications and demos that showcase SDK capabilities and serve as integration references for customers.
  • Create clear, comprehensive SDK documentation and integration guides.
  • Work with developer relations and support teams to address customer integration challenges.
  • Raise the bar for quality and operational excellence by establishing best practices around testing, observability, releases, and code health.
  • Contribute to a culture of ownership and execution, leading by example through hands-on work, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep focus on mobile development and shipping production-grade SDKs
  • Demonstrated track record of building and shipping high-quality code, with work you can point to and discuss in depth
  • Strong hands-on experience with iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin); experience with React Native or other cross-platform frameworks, and familiarity with all.
  • Experience building mobile SDKs or shared libraries, including API design, versioning, packaging, and long-term maintenance across platforms.
  • Experience with blockchain-enabled mobile systems, including wallet flows, signing, and on-chain interactions.
  • Experience working on security-sensitive mobile software, such as key management, secure storage, cryptography, or financial products.
  • Strong grasp of mobile engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and observability.
  • A get-things-done mindset with the ability to independently own problems and deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Comfortable making long-term architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic and adaptable.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Remote role in a distributed team; preference for candidates in the Americas time zone

Big Advantages

  • Rust and/or WebAssembly (Wasm) experience, particularly building cross-platform SDKs consumed by mobile apps.
  • Experience designing shared core logic used across iOS and Android.
  • Experience with advanced mobile security primitives (secure hardware, MPC, low-level crypto).
  • Prior experience owning or founding a mobile platform or SDK from scratch.

For employees hired to work from our NYC HQ, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range is specific to New York City, and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs.

It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $177,000 to $230,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of you deciding to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are.

Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

Please see our candidate privacy policy here.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
descriptionText:
About TrackVia

At TrackVia, we don’t just build software, we empower organizations around the world to radically streamline operations and digitize frontline workflows with zero code required. Our platform powers everything from post-loan processing in finance, to sterile field audits in hospitals, to safety inspections on construction sites — all instantly deployable to native mobile with no additional engineering effort.

We’re looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer who is excited to build and evolve high-performance, offline-first native mobile applications across both Android and iOS, while partnering with a small, passionate team shaping the future of enterprise mobility.

What Makes Our Mobile Apps Unique
100% native, fully dynamic: our mobile apps render views, business logic, forms, and workflows in real time from a backend configuration engine.
Field-proven at scale: powering mission-critical workflows across construction, healthcare, utilities, financial services, government and more.
Offline-first by design: tens of thousands of records cached per user, with full CRUD functionality available with zero connectivity.
Shared core logic across platforms: a robust client rules engine powers consistent behavior across Android, iOS, and Web, while preserving native UX and performance.

This is not pixel-pushing on a consumer app. You’ll solve hard problems like offline data integrity, background sync under unstable networks, dynamic UI rendering, and performance tuning for real-world field environments.

What You’ll Do
Build and Evolve Our Native Mobile Applications
Design, develop, and maintain native iOS and Android applications, contributing meaningfully to both platforms.
Build dynamic, data-driven interfaces that render complex workflows at runtime.
Leverage modern mobile frameworks and platform capabilities to deliver secure, performant, and intuitive experiences.
Help shape and evolve our offline-first architecture, background sync mechanisms, and local data persistence strategies.
Champion Architecture, Quality, and Platform Consistency
Advocate for clean architecture, testable and maintainable code, and scalable mobile design patterns across platforms.
Design and maintain solutions for:
Offline data storage and conflict resolution
Background sync across variable network conditions
Secure data caching and encryption
Performance optimization and multi-threaded workloads
Write high-quality automated tests and integrate tightly with CI/CD pipelines for mobile delivery.
Raise the bar for security, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
Lead Through Collaboration and Mentorship
Partner closely with Product, Design, and Platform teams to deliver features that directly impact customers.
Collaborate with mobile, web, and backend engineers to ensure a cohesive, consistent multi-platform experience.
Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance.
Contribute to mobile roadmap decisions and technical direction.
Actively participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
What We’re Looking For
Must-Have Qualifications
6+ years of professional mobile engineering experience, with deep expertise in either Android or iOS and strong working experience on the other platform.
Proven experience building native mobile applications using one or both:
Android: Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, Jetpack / AndroidX
iOS: Swift, iOS SDKs, modern Apple frameworks
Strong understanding of mobile architecture patterns, lifecycle management, memory constraints, and concurrency.
Comfort designing and implementing custom UI components and dynamic layouts.
Experience writing high-coverage unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for mobile apps.
Hands-on experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines and app store deployment processes.
Familiarity with mobile security best practices and data protection strategies.
Ability and willingness to problem-solve outside of a single platform specialty.
Ability to leverage AI / LLMs to accelerate learning, implementation, and productivity.
Must be authorized to work in the United States.
Nice to Have
Balanced experience shipping native production features on both Android and iOS.
Experience building offline-capable mobile applications with local persistence and sync.
Experience with mobile analytics, accessibility standards, or enterprise-scale mobile deployments.
Familiarity with design collaboration tools like Figma, Zeplin, or Sketch.
Experience working in SaaS or B2B enterprise environments.
Exposure to shared logic strategies or cross-platform architectural alignment
Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
Why TrackVia?
Work How You Work Best: Remote-first culture with optional quarterly in-person gatherings in Denver.
Build a Force Multiplier: Your work enables non-technical users to build powerful, mission-critical mobile apps.
High Impact, Low Bureaucracy: Small teams, real ownership, and fast iteration.
Award-Winning Culture: Recognized by Built In Colorado and Outside Magazine as one of the best places to work.
Benefits
Fully remote with flexible schedules.
Unlimited PTO and a four-day workweek during summer months.
100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) with company match.
Paid parental leave after six months.

title: Web Developer
descriptionText:
*Job Overview*
Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in the Greater New Orleans Area, People Who Think, LLC is a full-service advertising agency seeking to hire a seasoned Web Developer to support the development of diverse web applications for clients and the agency. In addition, the position works closely with other team members to understand how to best formulate web solutions to promote client goals, meet specific online objectives and create engaging, user-friendly experiences across different platforms, browsers and devices.

*Responsibilities:*

* Design, develop, maintain and enhance systems based on business requirements using approved technologies and coding standards.
* Partner with internal teams to brainstorm innovations and problem-solve.
* Collaborate on UX/UI and design throughout the entire process, offering insights and setting development expectations.
* Interpret client needs and project specifications, identifying website user requirements–both technical and functional. Write technical requirement documentation for internal and external use.
* Recommend system solutions by comparing advantages and disadvantages of each–CMS comparison, custom build vs. template purchase, etc.
* Create API integrations with third-party legal software systems
* Create cost estimates based on tech specs and scope of work.
* Evaluate code to ensure it meets W3C and client’s standards.
* Ensure all new sites are optimized for search upon launch and update hosted sites quarterly to ensure continued optimization.
* Ensure quality assurance via internal and external testing. Troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating systems.
* Support the management and maintenance of multiple websites, including updating WordPress core files, themes, and plugins; adding or updating email addresses; and troubleshooting hosting and domain issues.
* Proactively identify problems, research solutions and collaborate with the team to devise plans to solve site-based issues.
* Proactively maintain an understanding of the latest web applications and programming practices through continuing education, participation in conferences, workshops and webinars.

*Requirements:*

* Instinctively motivated critical thinker with a voracious appetite for continued learning and a healthy dose of curiosity
* A minimum of 5 years development experience
* Proficient in WordPress custom theme and plugin development
* Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PHP, jQuery, JSON, MySQL, APIs, etc.
* Experience with payment processing platforms such as Paypal and Stripe
* Experience with setting up custom tags in Google Tag Manager
* Experience setting up GA4 and tracking events
* SEO fluent
* Familiarity with Expression Engine and other CMS platforms
* Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational skills
* Ability to learn and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment
* Able to handle the pressure of meeting tight deadlines
* Ability to clearly communicate expectations and solutions to a non-technical audience
* Communicate effectively and proactively with clients and internal team members
* United States citizen
* Ad agency experience a plus

People Who Think provides a benefit package including, medical, dental and vision insurance, a 4% match 401K program, paid time off and continuing education opportunities. Compensation commensurate with experience. Determination of whether position is 100% remote or partially remote dependant upon applicant’s match for the position.

Applications that do not meet the requirements as outlined will not be considered for this position.

Please email your resume, cover letter and full details of at least two development projects with active links to jobs@peoplewhothink.com

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

title: In-House Full-Stack Developer and AI Engineer
descriptionText:
*Position: In-House Full-Stack Developer and AI Engineer*

*Location: Hybrid in Greenville, SC with flexibility after onboarding. Our operations span the Southeast.*

*Compensation: $115,000 – $170,000 base salary, depending on experience, plus performance-based incentives tied to platform milestones and company growth*

*Note*: This is a permanent, in-house position. You will be a core member of our operating team, not an outside contractor or agency resource. You will sit alongside the people who use what you build, learn the business from the inside, and own the technology strategy across the entire company.

*About Us*

We are a vertically integrated real estate operating company headquartered in Upstate South Carolina with operations throughout the Southeast. Our subsidiaries span residential homebuilding, general contracting, real estate development, multifamily and build-to-rent asset management, property management, title services, affordable housing through a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, and venture capital and alternative investments. All of these entities operate under a family office holding company structure with shared ownership, shared strategy, and an increasing need for shared technology infrastructure.

We are building a technology-driven operating company where proprietary internal applications serve as the connective tissue across every business vertical. The homebuilder needs estimating tools, purchase order automation, and investor fund management. The general contractor needs project scheduling, draw management, and job cost tracking. The asset management function needs portfolio-level NOI analysis, capital expenditure planning, and hold/sell modeling. The property management company needs a full operating platform to replace its current third-party software. The title company needs document automation and closing coordination tools. And all of these need to talk to each other. A lot that our builder purchases, that our GC develops, that our PM company manages, that our title company closes on — the entire lifecycle of that asset should live in one connected data ecosystem. That is what you are here to build.

*The Role*

We are hiring our first in-house technology leader to own and build the internal software infrastructure across our entire portfolio of companies. This is not a contract engagement or an agency placement. This is a permanent seat on our operating team where you will build the technology layer of a vertically integrated real estate operating company from the ground up, make it your own, and grow with it.

You will work directly with the CEO, who will serve as your product owner and domain expert across homebuilding, general contracting, asset management, property management, law, and investment. You will also work alongside operational leaders in each business vertical who will teach you how the industry works from the inside. You bring the engineering and AI expertise. We bring decades of combined industry knowledge, the business context, and the problems worth solving. Together, we build applications that no one else in our industry has.

This role is designed for a builder who wants to own a technology stack, not just contribute to one. Someone who gets energized by learning a new industry and translating its complexity into elegant software. Someone who sees AI not as a future initiative but as an operational tool that should be deployed immediately to automate workflows, augment decision-making, and create compounding advantages across a multi-entity business.

*What You Will Build*

The immediate priorities, starting from day one, fall into two parallel tracks that run simultaneously, not sequentially.

*Track 1: *AI Systems and Automation Across All Entities. This is not a future phase. We need AI workflows, RAG pipelines, and intelligent automation deployed across our operations from your first weeks. This includes deploying and configuring self-hosted AI infrastructure as an organizational knowledge base spanning all entities, so that our team can query operating agreements, construction contracts, lease templates, investor documents, and financial records through natural language. Building AI-augmented workflows using n8n, Claude API, and MCP integrations for document processing, communication automation, data extraction, and decision support across the homebuilder, the GC, the PM company, and the title company. Integrating AI with our Microsoft 365 environment (Outlook, SharePoint) to automate email processing, document routing, and calendar management. And building AI agents that assist with deal underwriting, construction cost analysis, tenant screening evaluation, maintenance prioritization, and owner reporting.

*Track 2:* Internal Business Applications. We have an existing development platform built on Supabase that handles deal tracking and project management for the homebuilding and development side. You will maintain and extend this platform while building out new applications for the verticals that need them most. The first major build is a property management operating platform to replace our current third-party PM software, starting with the modules that software fails at: multi-entity accounting with trust accounting compliance, automated owner disbursements, and financial reporting that actually works for an operator managing properties across multiple LLCs. From there you build workflow automation for lease management, maintenance operations, and tenant communications. Payment collection via Stripe. Document generation and e-signature integration using self-hosted open source tools. Tenant and owner portals. And the asset management intelligence layer that connects development cost data to stabilized operating performance across the portfolio.

Beyond these two tracks, you will build and deploy tools for the homebuilder including investor fund reporting, lot acquisition analysis, and construction scheduling integration. For the general contractor, you will build project-level cost tracking, draw management workflows, and subcontractor coordination tools. For the title company, you will build document automation for closings, title commitment tracking, and client communication workflows. Each of these applications is a spoke on the same wheel, sharing the same Supabase data backbone, the same authentication system, and the same AI infrastructure, so that every application you build makes every other application smarter.

*Technical Environment*

Our current and target technology stack includes the following. Supabase (PostgreSQL) serves as our primary backend and database layer across all applications. React and Next.js are used for frontend development. n8n (self-hosted) handles workflow automation. DocuSeal (self-hosted) provides e-signature capabilities. Stripe powers payment processing. Plaid provides bank feed integration for reconciliation. SendGrid and Twilio handle email and SMS communications. AnythingLLM or equivalent serves as our self-hosted RAG and AI knowledge base. Claude API (Anthropic) and OpenAI APIs power AI agent workflows. Microsoft Graph API integrates with our Office 365 environment under the Red Cedar tenant. Appsmith (self-hosted) is being evaluated for internal admin dashboards. GitHub manages version control and CI/CD.

You will have full authority over architectural decisions within this stack. If you have strong opinions about better tools or approaches, we want to hear them. What matters is that we own our data, control our infrastructure, and build applications that compound on each other.

*Who You Are*

You have at least three years of professional experience as a full-stack developer, with demonstrated ability to independently architect and ship production applications end-to-end. You are deeply fluent in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. You have real, hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, including RAG systems, LLM integrations (Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent), vector databases, and AI agent workflows. This is not a nice-to-have. We need someone who can deploy AI infrastructure and build intelligent workflows from day one.

You have experience with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Temporal, or similar) and understand how to design event-driven architectures. You are comfortable with API integrations (REST, webhooks, OAuth) and have integrated payment processors, communication services, or financial data providers in production. You have worked with self-hosted infrastructure and are comfortable with Docker, Linux administration, and managing your own deployment pipeline.

Beyond the technical requirements, you thrive as a solo or small-team engineer in an entrepreneurial environment. You do not need a product manager to write tickets for you or a team lead to assign work. You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. You can context-switch between multiple applications and business domains without losing momentum. You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and can translate business problems into technical solutions.

You do not need to know real estate, property management, or construction. The CEO and team will teach you the industry. What you need is the engineering talent to build sophisticated applications and the curiosity to learn a complex, multi-entity business quickly.

*Preferred but Not Required*

Experience with financial applications, accounting systems, multi-tenant SaaS, or real estate technology. Familiarity with Supabase specifically. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations. Background in building customer-facing portals alongside internal tools. Experience scaling applications from hundreds to thousands of users.

*What We Offer*

A competitive base salary of $115,000 to $170,000 depending on experience, with performance incentives tied to platform delivery milestones. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance and paid time off. Direct partnership with the CEO on technology strategy across a portfolio that spans homebuilding, general contracting, asset management, property management, title services, nonprofit, and venture capital. The opportunity to build an entire technology ecosystem from the ground up across multiple business verticals, not maintain someone else’s legacy code. Real ownership of your work in a company where what you build directly drives enterprise value across every entity. A path to growing a technology team under your leadership as the portfolio scales toward 3,000+ managed units and expands its development pipeline. And full immersion in a diversified real estate operating company where you will learn every facet of the industry while building the software infrastructure that ties it all together.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $115,000.00 - $175,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance



Application Question(s):
* Describe a production application you built end-to-end. What was the stack, what problems did you solve, and what would you do differently today
* Describe an AI-powered system you built or deployed. What LLM, RAG, or automation components did you use, and what business problem did it solve?
* What is your expected annual base salary?

Experience:
* Professional Software Development: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greenville, SC 29609

Technical Environment

Our current and target technology stack includes the following. Supabase (PostgreSQL) serves as our primary backend and database layer across all applications. React and Next.js are used for frontend development. n8n (self-hosted) handles workflow automation. DocuSeal (self-hosted) provides e-signature capabilities. Stripe powers payment processing. Plaid provides bank feed integration for reconciliation. SendGrid and Twilio handle email and SMS communications. AnythingLLM or equivalent serves as our self-hosted RAG and AI knowledge base. Claude API (Anthropic) and OpenAI APIs power AI agent workflows. Microsoft Graph API integrates with our Office 365 environment under the Red Cedar tenant. Appsmith (self-hosted) is being evaluated for internal admin dashboards. GitHub manages version control and CI/CD.

You will have full authority over architectural decisions within this stack. If you have strong opinions about better tools or approaches, we want to hear them. What matters is that we own our data, control our infrastructure, and build applications that compound on each other.
